ops.body: Prepared follow-up PR199 at2b61cb9fe14ef33a98795b6d7b94318bd2bb16e9: private bootstrap reuses canonical Map.Build instead of per-row graph replacement; transaction-local count cache flushes only net changes, preserving existing validation/GC/retention. New tests compare final root/object/count bytes with incremental construction, ensure neutral count changes dirty no extra pages, and cover repeated flush/deletion/cancellation. Hosted checks are running. Independent reviewer admission was rejected by the exhausted100-dollar conservative estimate cap; requested one bounded5-dollar reviewer specifically for this patch. No local tests/builds/benchmarks ran. CLI/helper0.75.1 and all three known-store bootstraps are verified; performance criteria remain open.
